# Aniket Patidar

> Software engineer in India who builds Rails backends for fintech, including open banking integrations and credit-decisioning work. He has been at CodeNote IT Solutions since 2022, starting as an intern.

## When to use this site
- You need information about Aniket Patidar, his work, or his professional background.
- You are looking for first-hand writing on Ruby on Rails.
- You need verifiable evidence of his work: merged pull requests, recommendations, or project write-ups.

## Key facts
- Led the zero-downtime upgrade of Kreditz's external API from Rails 6.1 to 8.0.1 (client work at CodeNote).
- Integrated Yapily alongside Klarna to keep access to bank data during third-party outages.
- Other client work at CodeNote: MyWearToday (an AI digital closet on Next.js, Inngest, and the Gemini API) and Printrizz (a print-on-demand marketplace on NestJS and Next.js).
- Built Moneygun's open-source notification system: https://github.com/yshmarov/moneygun/pull/286
- Open-source contributions also include Ruby for Good's Human Essentials (two data fixes), KlinicCon (Rails models and a React component), and Enable Banking's open banking eIDAS broker (TLS port fix).
- Contact: aniketpatidar01@gmail.com

## Site structure
- `/`: Introduction and latest writing.
- `/about/`: Career, client work, and open source in brief.
- `/career/`: Everything worked on since 2022, year by year, written from a daily work log.
- `/projects/`: Selected projects, each marked as personal or client work.
- `/contributions/`: Open-source contributions, with links to the pull requests.
- `/recommendations/`: Recommendations from colleagues and an open-source maintainer.
- `/posts/`: All writing.
- `/resume/`: Full resume.
- `/contact/`: How to get in touch.
- `/sitemap.xml`: Full map of all pages.

## Agent guidelines
Please respect robots.txt. Markdown representations of pages are available via standard content negotiation.
